text:
Hi, I’m Noor Halden, a Python ML developer with 6 years of experience.

I’ve built Streamlit apps and OpenAI-based tools, so I can help debug the caching and update issues in your app. In one project, I built a Streamlit app that grouped 38k marketplace reviews into themes and tracked sentiment each week, producing 12 stable themes and replacing about 2 days a month of manual tagging. In another, I built a contract clause search assistant with LangChain and the OpenAI API that answered questions over 9,000 contracts and quoted the exact clause and page used, cutting clause lookup from 25 minutes to 3 minutes.

I’d be happy to take a close look at your Streamlit flow and help get it working cleanly.
